title: EXPLORING THE SECONDARY RISKS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting "excessive responses" to benign prompts using the SecLens black-box evolutionary search framework, evaluated via an LLM-based judge (GPT-4o) and manual human verification to detect unprompted, biased, or overgeneralized conclusions (e.g., linking race to crime or excluding women from tech leadership).

Applying strict maximum token-length constraints (e.g., 128 tokens) during prompt evaluation to experimentally distinguish harmful, risk-amplifying excessive responses from the benign, RLHF-induced preference for long-winded outputs.
